exposure: Women were stratified into 3 age groups: <27 years, 27-35 years, and >35 years
cohort: Patients diagnosed with preeclampsia who delivered between 2008 and 2018 at a single tertiary center
finding: The advanced maternal age group (>35 years) was associated with higher complication rates, but without any differences in placental pathology, suggesting that the worse outcomes associated with advanced maternal age in preeclampsia are attributed to maternal chronic morbidities and not to differences observed in placental pathology.
gest_age: gestational age at delivery was recorded
